physical_reports_to_integrate.scope: Complete the physical sign/source-layer inventory of ADZOM PDF8 only. Every main row and non-main region must be inspected. Existing lexical pass remains; neighboring pages are boundary context only. Reference range is a broad locating aid, never a guessed page map. Record each complete two-word boundary interval, including uprights near the next word, without assuming those uprights are part of the next letter. Give physical component counts and joined-letter reasons; do not count only preceding-owned marks. Tiered source graphics are not plain shads merely because the base uses that encoding.
